title: The Drowned Town
logline: In a dry year the water behind a dam drops, and the streets of a town that was flooded decades ago come back into the air. People who grew up there walk out across the cracked mud, looking for a house that is no longer where they remember it.
human_question: When the map we carry no longer matches the ground, how do we find our way?

premise.story: Former residents of a town submerged by a reservoir return while the drawdown lasts. They try to find their old houses, schools and temple among the foundations, and often disagree about which ruin was which.
premise.place: The exposed bed of a hill-country reservoir during drought: cracked mud, stumps, steps leading nowhere, the waterline high on the hills around.
premise.experience: The viewer walks a lost place with the only people who can read it, and feels the disorientation of memory meeting ground that has moved on.

concept_links.why: The source's latent tendencies lie hidden and 'rise up when a suitable object is found'; it also names going over past misfortunes as a source of worry and restlessness. The town under the water is an image of what lies low until conditions change, not an illustration of anyone's mind.

The general sense of doubt as a mind that cannot settle on what is in front of it [C008-P:L34]: people standing on foundations, unable to agree where they are. The source's harmful doubt is narrower, so this is an image, not an equivalence.

what_camera_could_observe: The waterline stain high on the surrounding hills, and the town floor far below it
Former residents stepping onto the mud, pointing, pacing out a street, arguing gently about which foundation was whose
Objects surfacing: steps, a well, tiles, a doorway, the remains of a place of worship
Old photographs held up against the present view, if families have them
The first rain and the water beginning to come back
what_must_be_real: The drought, the drawdown and the returning residents must all be real. No one is brought to the site for the camera, and no memory is scripted.

possible_arc.opening: Wide, silent mud and a line of steps walking into nothing.
possible_arc.turn: Someone finds the thing they were looking for, or realises they cannot find it.
possible_arc.ending_open: The water returns and the town goes under again. What the residents actually say or do as it disappears leads the ending.

position_hint: opening candidate: a place that has literally lost its way, and a possible Object 4 acquisition moment only if something real happens there (for example a gift or a found thing offered by a resident); nothing may be staged

requirements: A reservoir whose drawdown genuinely exposes the remains of a submerged settlement during the filming window
Former residents or their families willing to return and speak
Safe access onto the exposed bed and permission from the relevant authorities

suggestions.name: Victoria Reservoir (old Teldeniya area)
suggestions.why: A large Mahaweli reservoir whose construction submerged settlements; remains of the old town have been reported to reappear in severe droughts.
suggestions.season_notes: Only in drought years, when water levels fall far enough; unpredictable
suggestions.verify: Confirm which settlements were submerged, whether remains have actually re-emerged, and who manages access.

suggestions.name: Kotmale Reservoir area
suggestions.why: Another Mahaweli reservoir built over inhabited valleys; low water has reportedly exposed older structures.
suggestions.verify: Unverified; confirm what is actually exposed at low water and whether former residents live nearby.

risks: Grief and displacement filmed as spectacle; the resettlement history may be painful and politically sensitive
Depends entirely on weather; may not happen in any given year
drop_if: No drawdown exposes the remains during the development window
Former residents do not wish to return with a camera

connections.note: Two ways to open the group: a place that has lost its bearings, or a traveller who has.
Opens in a place that cannot be seen clearly because it is covered; the closing candidate ends in fog that is moved through by slowing down.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
Whether any submerged settlement has re-emerged recently, and when it might again, is unconfirmed.
